dedupe_keys.name: inventory of online public databases and repositories holding agricultural data 2017 usda national agricultural library

description: A landscape inventory of where US agricultural researchers can publish and find open agricultural data. The Ag Data Commons record says it aggregates the main sources of agriculture-related data, meaning general research repositories, domain-specific databases and the top journals, to show where land grant and USDA researchers (mainly ARS, NRCS, USFS and other agencies) deposit data and how much sits in institutional, domain-specific and federal platforms, as a baseline for future studies and for the Ag Data Commons. It holds downloadable CSV tables of domain-specific agricultural databases (91 KB), general repositories, repositories named by journals, journals, and a data dictionary, with a README and a TDWG presentation, under CC0, published in 2017 by Erin Antognoli, Jonathan Sears and Cynthia Parr. Coverage is sources used by US agricultural research in 2017. Caveats: a 2017 snapshot, so links and repositories may have changed. For simulation it is a finding aid: a list of agricultural databases to search for farm, crop, soil and water data when building farm and food system models. A related catalogue record is the ICASA data standards and master variable list.
